assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles turned fragile nucleic acids into deliverable drugs: rational lipid design (pKa-tuned ionizable lipids, PEG-lipids, microfluidic mixing) made siRNA and mRNA therapeutics and vaccines practical. Transformative for what clinicians can do, and a clear chemistry-driven enabling technology that the 2023 Medicine prize on nucleoside modification did not cover.
assessment.attribution: Cullis, Hope and Madden built the foundational LNP formulation and ionizable-lipid concepts in Vancouver; the field is crowded (MacLachlan, Anderson, Langer and others), so a clean three-person split is contestable and the choice of Cullis, Hope and Madden is my judgment from memory.
assessment.maturity: Clinically validated at global scale (siRNA drug patisiran, COVID-19 mRNA vaccines), with independent confirmation by many groups; recognition is timely.
uncertainties: Proportion of credit between the Vancouver founders and later optimizers of ionizable lipids (e.g. MacLachlan, Anderson) is unresolved.
Possible reluctance to reward delivery vehicles so soon after the 2023 Medicine prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one base into another at a target site without double-strand breaks, a molecular design achievement (engineered deaminase fused to a programmable DNA binder) that gives precise control over recognition and reactivity and is already moving into clinical use.
assessment.attribution: David R. Liu is the clear intellectual driver; Komor (cytosine base editors) and Gaudelli (adenine base editors) carried out the decisive first demonstrations as his trainees. Giving Liu alone, or with these two, are both defensible; I include the two first authors for completeness.
assessment.maturity: Many independent groups confirm and extend the technology, and first clinical cases (e.g. sickle cell and other base-edited therapies) have appeared; timely but the long-term clinical record is short.
uncertainties: Whether the committee views this as sufficiently distinct from the 2020 CRISPR prize.
Overlap with the prime editing candidate B007, which shares Liu as principal figure.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation reframes pharmacology: bifunctional PROTACs and molecular glues hijack E3 ligases to remove proteins instead of inhibiting them, opening previously undruggable targets. A chemical design principle with broad translational reach.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and developed PROTACs, while Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, explaining glue degraders; Ciulli, Gray and others contributed key later advances (VHL ligands, optimized degraders), so the allocation is difficult and the three-person choice is a judgment.
assessment.maturity: Many degraders are in clinical trials, but approval of a PROTAC drug is still pending in my recollection; the concept is firmly established, the therapeutic proof is still maturing.
uncertainties: Eight credited names compress into at most three laureates; Ciulli, Gray and Sakamoto contributions are left out.
Lack of an approved PROTAC drug may make timing premature for some members.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Expansion of the genetic code with orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs lets researchers install designed chemical functionality site-specifically in proteins in living cells, a general molecular-design tool for biomaterials, sensors, therapeutics and chemical biology.
assessment.attribution: Schultz and Wang established the first in vivo unnatural amino acid incorporation; Chin extended it to eukaryotes, multiple codons and genome-wide recoded organisms. Yokoyama and Mehl contributed but a three-person set seems fairest.
assessment.maturity: Widely used for two decades with independent confirmation; applications such as antibody-drug conjugates and recoded organisms are increasingly mature.
uncertainties: Unresolved ordering of credit among Schultz, Wang and Chin.
Impact is mostly as a research tool rather than a transformed therapy.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sensing converts single-molecule chemistry into an electrical read-out and has produced portable DNA/RNA sequencers; it is a strong case of a molecular-recognition and engineering concept becoming a field-deployable analytical technology that clinicians and field researchers use.
assessment.attribution: Deamer, Branton and Akeson proposed and demonstrated DNA translocation and sequencing concepts; Bayley engineered protein pores and sensing. Kasianowicz demonstrated the first single-strand detection. I am uncertain about the current status of some of the older pioneers, which could constrain eligibility.
assessment.maturity: Commercial devices are in routine use and independently validated; the technology is mature.
uncertainties: Whether all credited pioneers are living is uncertain to me.
Priority disputes among the early conceptual contributions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: DNA origami and tile assembly give nanometer-precise, programmable molecular architectures, a design principle for assembly with wide use in biosensing, nanophotonics and drug delivery.
assessment.attribution: Rothemund's 2006 scaffolded origami is the decisive contribution; Winfree's algorithmic self-assembly and Yan's structural DNA nanotechnology are important. Nadrian Seeman, the founder of the field, is not in the credited list and was deceased in 2021, which complicates attribution.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent confirmation and a large community, but real-world applications beyond research tools are still emerging.
uncertainties: Absence of the field's founder from the credited names makes a fair allocation hard.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Activity-based protein profiling uses reactive chemical probes to read out enzyme function in native proteomes, enabling discovery of druggable sites and inhibitors; it is a core chemical-biology and bioanalytical toolkit.
assessment.attribution: Cravatt is the principal originator and leading developer; Bogyo and Overkleeft contributed influential probe designs for proteases and glycosidases. Weerapana's role is more incremental.
assessment.maturity: Well replicated and widely adopted, with covalent-ligand discovery linked to clinical programs; mature.
uncertainties: Credit beyond Cravatt may be contested; a single-laureate award is possible.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Shokat's chemical-genetic and covalent strategies, including analog-sensitive kinases and the cysteine-targeting KRAS G12C inhibitors, drew an apparently undruggable oncogene into therapeutics and changed what clinicians can offer patients.
assessment.attribution: A single-author candidate with clearly attributable decisive contributions; competing work on KRAS inhibitors by pharma teams is not credited here.
assessment.maturity: KRAS G12C inhibitors are approved and independently developed, giving strong clinical confirmation; timely.
uncertainties: Single laureate would leave the wider covalent-drug field unrecognized.
Share of credit relative to industry development teams.
